readme: Pinned upstream sources for the vendored .proto tree in ./proto. Run `pnpm proto:sync` to re-materialize it; CI runs `pnpm proto:check`, which syncs and fails on any diff. Bumping a commit is a deliberate, reviewable change — the diff shows exactly what the wire contract gained.

sources.name: skywalking-banyandb-client-proto
sources.note: Predates BanyanDB 0.11.0: carries replicas, sharding_key and mod_revision, but no SchemaBarrierService, no STATUS_SCHEMA_NOT_APPLIED and no created_at.

sources.name: protoc-gen-validate
sources.note: Every banyandb .proto does `import "validate/validate.proto"`, and the BanyanDB proto repo does not vendor it — without this the tree does not load at all. google/protobuf/* needs no entry: @grpc/proto-loader carries the well-known types.
